en: A vintage black‑and‑white photograph printed with a wide white border, showing a rural farm scene. A young barefoot girl in a light dress stands on grass, watching a group of piglets feeding together. A dog stands behind the piglets, looking toward the camera. In the background, there is a simple dirt yard with wooden fencing, a bucket, and the lower half of an adult person in work clothes and boots. The overall style resembles an old real‑photo postcard from a European farm.
